metadata.description: Crew: a standing team of expert colleagues for your projects: hire them, run review rounds, talk with them one-to-one or in meetings.

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: Skill and hook: set up a team of expert colleagues, hire, fire and portray them, run review rounds, talk with them one-to-one or in meetings.

plugins.name: crew-mod
plugins.description: Mod: the Crew panel, the colleagues with portraits, who is at work and the steps they report, the week's budget; meetings drawn as a group chat, with controls to invite, let go and close.
